title: ר' חנינא טירטאה

paragraphs: R. Chanina Tirtaa, in R. Yochanan's time. Menachot 48a: R. Chanina Tirta taught before R. Yochanan; Rashi explains it as a place-name. Temurah 29a: Rav Chananyah Tritaa before R. Yochanan. There, 31: R. Chanina. He asked R. Yochanan: Keritot 9a, near the end. Yuchasin writes R. Chiyya Tirnai—so too Tosafot, Shabbat 72a, R. Chiyya Tirnai—student of R. Yochanan in Arba Mechusserei Kapparah. The reading before us there is R. Chanina. It grants a deed to two parties [i.e., assigns the same matter twice].
